name: Anatomy
note: What every new dragonfly is born with

items.name: Iron Mandibles
items.text: +1 base power

items.name: Serrated Jaw
items.text: +2 base power

items.name: Crushing Bite
items.text: +5 base power

items.name: Chitin Plates
items.text: +1 base health

items.name: Hardened Thorax
items.text: +3 base health

items.name: Armoured Line
items.text: +10 base health

items.name: Thick Hide
items.text: every strike against it does 1 less damage

items.name: Long Wings
items.text: +10% base speed

items.name: Storm Wings
items.text: +25% base speed

items.name: Split Wingbeat
items.text: +15% base turning

items.name: Counterweight Tail
items.text: +15% base acceleration

items.name: Wide Spiracles
items.text: +20% base stamina

items.name: Quick Jaws
items.text: bites land 10% faster

items.name: Long Reach
items.text: catches prey from 25% farther

items.name: Warm Blood
items.text: resting restores stamina and health 25% faster

items.name: Giant's Blood
items.text: +10% to every base stat

name: Appetite
note: How much blood a hunt pays

items.name: Sharp Hunger
items.text: +10% blood from every kill

items.name: Rich Blood
items.text: +25% blood from every kill

items.name: Glutton
items.text: +50% blood from every kill

items.name: Swarm Feast
items.text: gnats pay 1 more blood

items.name: Clean Kill
items.text: +50% blood for a kill made in one hold

items.name: First Blood
items.text: the first kill of each enemy type in a run pays 5 times

items.name: Killing Streak
items.text: each kill within 5 s of the last pays 10% more, up to double

items.name: Big Game
items.text: enemies above Normal pay 30% more

items.name: Second Helping
items.text: 1 kill in 10 pays twice

items.name: Trophy
items.text: finishing a quest pays 20 blood

items.name: Head Start
items.text: begin each run with 50 blood

items.name: Inheritance
items.text: begin each run with 10% of the blood spent in the last one

items.name: Bargain
items.text: the first level of every stat is free

items.name: Lean Growth
items.text: upgrade prices rise 10% slower

items.name: Salvage
items.text: death refunds 75% instead of 50%

items.name: Long Memory
items.text: +10% evolution points from every run

name: Instinct
note: Skills the hunter is born knowing

items.name: Dive Strike
items.text: the first bite after hitting an enemy at top speed does double damage

items.name: Ambush
items.text: the first bite on an enemy that has not fled does triple damage

items.name: Death Grip
items.text: enemies take twice as long to break free

items.name: Lock Jaw
items.text: enemies below 25% health cannot break free

items.name: Wing Clip
items.text: the first bite tears the wings, an escaped enemy flees at half speed

items.name: Bleed
items.text: a bitten enemy loses 1 health each second for 5 s

items.name: Frenzy
items.text: each kill speeds up biting by 10% for 5 s, up to 50%

items.name: Blood Rush
items.text: a kill restores 20% health

items.name: Tailwind
items.text: +30% speed for 2 s after a kill

items.name: Air Brake
items.text: stops from full speed almost at once

items.name: Thermal
items.text: gliding costs no stamina

items.name: Feeding Rest
items.text: eating restores stamina

items.name: Meal on the Wing
items.text: keeps flying at half speed while eating

items.name: Perch Hunter
items.text: bites do 50% more for 5 s after leaving a rest spot

items.name: Sidestep
items.text: 1 strike in 5 misses

items.name: First Guard
items.text: the first strike of every fight does no damage

items.name: Last Stand
items.text: survives one killing blow per run with 1 health

items.name: Dread
items.text: Easy and Normal enemies no longer flee

items.name: Sky Eye
items.text: shows every enemy's health without hovering

name: Swarm
note: More dragonflies, and how they hunt together

items.name: Second Dragonfly
items.text: a second dragonfly hunts by itself

items.name: Third Dragonfly
items.text: a third dragonfly joins

items.name: Fourth Dragonfly
items.text: a fourth dragonfly joins

items.name: Fifth Dragonfly
items.text: a fifth dragonfly joins

items.name: Open Sky
items.text: the stage grows to hold more than 5 dragonflies

items.name: Keen Scouts
items.text: dragonflies hunting by themselves spot prey 30% farther

items.name: Bold Hunters
items.text: they also take Normal enemies

items.name: Fearless Hunters
items.text: they also take Slightly difficult enemies

items.name: Tireless
items.text: they rest 25% less

items.name: Long Hunt
items.text: they take 2 more catches before resting

items.name: Territory
items.text: no two dragonflies chase the same enemy

items.name: Lead the Hunt
items.text: the swarm attacks whatever you attack

items.name: Marked Prey
items.text: the enemy you attack takes 25% more damage from the others

items.name: Pack Hunt
items.text: two dragonflies on one enemy bite 50% harder

items.name: Surround
items.text: an enemy with three dragonflies near it cannot flee

items.name: Shared Kill
items.text: every dragonfly near a kill is paid for it

items.name: Elders
items.text: a dragonfly alive for 10 minutes gains 10% to every stat

items.name: Nursery
items.text: new dragonflies start with half of your upgrade levels

items.name: Hive Mind
items.text: manual control ends, every dragonfly hunts at full skill and takes any enemy it can beat
